blocks.text: Deal Desk reviews every non-standard term before Sales sends an order form to the customer.
If discount exceeds 20%, Finance approves it; if liability exceeds the standard cap, Legal approves it; if customer data is processed, Privacy approves the DPA.
Sales may obtain Finance, Legal, and Privacy approvals in parallel, but must attach all required approvals to the redline package before signature.

messages.text: Correction: current Deal Desk practice records conditional approvals in the CRM approval record, not in an email thread.
